test_case.title: Account locks after 5 consecutive failed login attempts
preconditions: Assumption: The user account is active and not locked
steps: Attempt to log in with 5 incorrect passwords consecutively
test_case.expected_result: The account becomes locked and displays a message instructing the user to check their email to unlock it or wait 30 minutes.

test_case.title: Successful login resets the failed attempt counter
preconditions: Assumption: The user account is locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts
steps: Attempt to log in with the correct password
test_case.expected_result: The account becomes unlocked and the failed attempt counter resets to zero.

test_case.title: Account displays a message instructing the user to check their email to unlock it
preconditions: Assumption: The user account is locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts
steps: Attempt to log in with the locked account
test_case.expected_result: The account displays a message instructing the user to check their email to unlock it or wait 30 minutes.

steps: Enter incorrect password 5 times consecutively within a short period (e.g., less than 1 minute)
test_case.expected_result: Account is locked and displays a message instructing the user to check their email to unlock it or wait 30 minutes.

test_case.title: Account Lockout with Special Characters in Password

preconditions: Assumption: User account is initially unlocked
